about: The heading of a reading from the Epistle of Saint Paul to the Philippians. The 1962 Roman Missal prints it over the Epistles of the Third Sunday of Advent, of Palm Sunday, of the 22nd and 23rd Sundays after Pentecost and of the Exaltation of the Holy Cross.

s01.translation: A reading from the Epistle of blessed Paul the Apostle to the Philippians
